question: What combination of power and victory over illusion is affirmed of Rama?
premises: He is described as possessing great enjoyment or lordship.
inference: Rama overcomes illusion while embodying great lordly power and strength.
uncertainties: mahā-bhogaḥ can mean great enjoyment or great lordship.
plain_english: Slayer of the illusory Maricha, possessed of great lordship, and mighty-armed.
